bear_assumptions: USD 0.60 normalized diluted EPS at 15x as take-rate compression, merchant concentration, regulatory costs, weak capital deployment or renewed cash-conversion pressure impair growth; merchant settlement cash is excluded from corporate liquidity and the new facility is not treated as value creation.
base_assumptions: USD 0.85 normalized diluted EPS at 22x as raised TPV and gross-profit guidance converts into sustained operating leverage and normalized cash conversion, while repurchase cancellation exceeds employee-plan dilution and credit-facility deployment remains disciplined.
bull_assumptions: USD 1.05 normalized diluted EPS at 28x as geographic and product expansion, operating leverage, cash conversion, repurchases and disciplined capital deployment outperform without a material merchant, tax, regulatory or foreign-exchange setback.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade from watch only after an accepted causal relationship clears the final gate while raised guidance, operating leverage, cash conversion and per-share growth remain supported; downgrade if gross-profit-over-TPV compression persists without earnings leverage, major merchants are lost or repriced, cash conversion reverses, the new facility is poorly deployed, regulatory or tax sanctions arise, settlement liquidity is restricted, litigation becomes material, or dilution offsets growth.
